author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಿಳಿಯದೆಯೆ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಅರಿಯದೆಯೆ ವಿದ್ಯೆಗಳ
ಎಳೆತಂದು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಹರು ಅನುಭವದ ಕಂತೆ
ಬಳಸಿಹರು ಅರಿವುಗಳ ಆಡುಮಾತಿಗೆ ತಂದು
ತಿಳಿವುಗಳೆ ಜೀವನವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Without knowing any techniques, without formal learning,
our elders drew out and handed us a bundle of experience;
they put their understanding into everyday speech;
such knowing is itself life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Our elders had no formal training, yet they passed on a wealth of lived experience in plain words and sayings. That practical wisdom is what life is made of.
